description:
Fetch real-time cryptocurrency price from CoinGecko API.
        
Returns current price, 24h change, and trading volume for any supported cryptocurrency.

**Use Case:** Get instant price data before executing trades or analyzing positions.

**Cost:** $0.005 USD per call (cheapest tier - high frequency allowed)

**Example Response:**
{
  "symbol": "bitcoin",
  "price_usd": 67842.50,
  "change_24h": 2.34,
  "volume_24h": 28500000000,
  "timestamp": "2026-08-24T15:30:00Z"
}
name: fetch_price

cost_usd.description: USD fee charged for the call.

data.description: Normalized price_usd, change_24h, volume_24h, and timestamp.

error.description: Error detail when success is false.
